content: The American Diabetes Association (ADA) recommends the use of GLP-1 receptor agonists for reducing cardiovascular risk in patients who have type 2 diabetes and chronic kidney disease (CKD), provided their estimated glomerular filtration rate (eGFR) is at least 20 mL/min/1.73 m². This recommendation is particularly relevant for patients who are unable to tolerate SGLT2 inhibitors.
